name: Model Viewer
rationale: Clean-room CSS 3D implementation from the effect description only: a procedural faceted product (or author-supplied inline CSS 3D/SVG markup) turns 360 degrees with drag and keyboard control, with no three.js, no model files and no external assets.

speed.description: Auto-rotation speed, in degrees per second.

autoRotate.description: Turn the model slowly while it is on screen and idle.

tilt.description: Camera tilt (rotateX), in degrees; negative looks down on the model.

size.description: Diameter of the procedural model, in px.

height.description: Height of the procedural model, in px.

colour.description: Body colour of the procedural model.

accent.description: Lid, label band and focus-ring colour.

interactive.description: Drag to spin; the host becomes focusable and the arrow keys rotate it (Home resets).

resumeDelay.description: Idle time after a drag or key press before auto-rotation resumes, in ms.

a11y: The generated model and floor shadow are aria-hidden; the host carries the accessible name (the demo uses role="img" with an aria-label that also says how to rotate it).

With interactive on, the host is focusable (tabindex 0 unless the author set one) with a visible :focus-visible ring; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight turn it 15 degrees, ArrowUp/ArrowDown tilt it, and Home resets, so keyboard users get the same control as drag.
touch-action: pan-y keeps vertical page scrolling on touch screens; only horizontal drags spin the model.
Reduced motion stops the auto-rotation, drag inertia and idle float; the model rests at a three-quarter view and moves only on direct user input.
